data.description:
## Observation
- `.github/workflows/_mutation.yml` sets `REBAR_MUTATION_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED: "1"` unconditionally on the `Run mutation shard` step of the `bounded mutation gate` job.
- Run 41939410124 (Gerrit change 3328, 2026-11-04 PST, runner image ubuntu-24.04): every shard log shows `bwrap is installed but cannot create a namespace (bwrap: setting up uid map: Permission denied)` followed by `REBAR_MUTATION_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED is set: running mutation tests UNSANDBOXED`, and all 7 shards concluded `success`. The only trace of the waiver is a warning line in the step log; `summary.json`, the job conclusion and the Verified vote are identical to a sandboxed pass.
- Run 42702801672 (change 3335, 2026-11-09 PST, ubuntu-26.04): bwrap 0.11.1 starts, the waiver line is absent, and the sandboxed path ran.

## Impact
On any runner where bwrap cannot create a namespace, mutated code runs with write access to the whole runner and the gate still reports green as though it were sandboxed. The 2026-08-26 destructive-mutation incident (`e668-b496-e264-4283`) is the hazard the sandbox exists for. The waiver also hid the basetemp bind-mount defect (`unwasteful-increased-colt`) for its whole life, because the sandboxed path never executed in CI.

## Approach
Remove the unconditional waiver from the mutation lane so the gate fails closed (`SandboxUnavailable`) when bwrap cannot start, now that the hosted image starts bwrap. Update the workflow comments that say hosted Ubuntu denies namespaces. Make the sandbox mechanism (or the waiver) visible in `summary.json` so a reader of the evidence can tell a sandboxed pass from a waived one. No new config key, env var or feature flag.

## Scope
- `.github/workflows/_mutation.yml` (drop the waiver, fix the stale comments)
- `scripts/mutation_gate.py` (record the mechanism in the summary; turn `SandboxUnavailable` into a `GateError` so the failure lands in `summary.json`)
- `tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` fixtures if they pin the env block

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The mutation lane no longer sets `REBAR_MUTATION_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED`, and a shard on a runner without a working sandbox fails with a summary that names the missing sandbox.
- [ ] `summary.json` records which sandbox mechanism ran each shard.
data.title: Mutation lane waives the sandbox unconditionally, so a runner where bwrap cannot start reports green as if sandboxed
